messages:
matt: Heads-up — planning incremental rollout for runtime v2.4 across EU -> US. Canary first, then staged ramp. Need console + router handshake, and a telemetry gate before we go wide. Deploy window 02:00-03:00 UTC. ping @olivia @sanjay

olivia: ack. will sync console feature-flag schedule. what telemetry events do we need to gate on?

sanjay: router side: need header split compatibility verified. we’re doing header: x-rw-model-version switch; router must accept both header formats for 30m. will spray 1% traffic during canary.

matt: telemetry gate = token-latency p95, error-rate (generation errors), and kv-eviction rate. rough thresholds: p95 < 220ms, generation errors < 0.8%, kv-eviction anomaly none. if any breach during canary rollback immediately and pin to v2.3.

amy: deploy-bot preflight run shows console schema change required for structured outputs. @olivia can you confirm console deploy plan?

olivia: console plan: flip feature flag in two stages. 02:05 small patch that exposes schema v2 opt-in, 02:20 flag for 10% UI traffic, 02:30 full flag for canary traffic. will post exact runbook in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: infra quotas OK, reserved GPUs available, service tokens valid. Starting canary at 6155551245. Canary traffic set to 1% to eu-prod cluster.

matt: rollout note for ops: if generation errors >= 1% for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 3m -> pause and rollback. amy to own rollback pin. ops-oncall monitor logs for 5xx spikes.

ops-oncall: confirmed. alert rule set: "runtime_generation_error_rate > 0.8% for 5m" and "runtime_p95_latency > 300ms for 3m" will page SEV2.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot at +3m: tokens/sec 1200, generation_errors 0.2%, p95 180ms, kv_evictions baseline. No flags tripped.

amy: good. starting canary verification checklist now: sample LLM outputs for top-20 prompts, run rerank smoke, validate structured outputs parsing.

matt: also ensure router header fallback logic is behaving. sanjay, coordinate a small header-swap smoke: route 0.5% with x-rw-model-version=v2.4 and 0.5% without. verify both responses accepted by console.

sanjay: started header-swap test at 6155551265. initial look: 0.03% mismatch on schema parsing (console side). tagging @olivia.

olivia: saw that — quick console tolerance patch deployed to ignore extra field. will re-run parsing check. note added to release notes.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics at +10m: tokens/sec 1500, generation_errors 0.5%, p95 210ms. telemetry gate OK.

matt: excellent. schedule staged ramp to 5% at 02:30 UTC, then 25% at 02:45 if no regressions. document rollback command to pin:
```
# pin to previous stable
cloudctl runtime pin --service runtime --version v2.3 --reason "auto-rollback: canary breach"
```

amy: noted. will run pin if we see error threshold. also will mark a canary sig-block in release notes.

ops-oncall: watching for increased kv_eviction signals, will escalate if we see correlation with latency.

matt: final call — any blockers before we go to 5% at 02:30?

olivia: none from console. flag schedule ready.

sanjay: router config ok, will keep header compatibility for at least 1hr post-ramp.

amy: rollback plan in place, release notes updated, release-manager checklist completed.

deploy-bot: Staged ramp scheduled: 5% at 6155551400, 25% at 6155551500. Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #prod-telemetry, #ops.

matt: thanks team. will monitor first 30m and then sign off for full rollout. :thumbsup:
